verdict.rationale: The Wally CLI runs both local models (offline, no account) and RunAnywhere-hosted cloud models from the same interface, keeping the same tools. A `--cloud` flag switches between them, and the docs say hosted versus local is always an explicit choice. However, the only cloud backend evidenced is RunAnywhere's own hosted service, not third-party cloud AI providers. missing for 10: connecting third-party cloud providers (e.g. bringing your own provider/API key) alongside local models, SDK-level hybrid cloud/local routing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hybrid workflow.
